# Cubism SDK for Web 5-r.5

These files are copied from the official `CubismSdkForWeb-5-r.5.zip` supplied by the user for local development (archive SHA-256 `67064a7fb1812cf502f5c4a03bfe12cc638c75a621bb4acf06bb28763df06ba0`). `Core/` is proprietary software; `Framework/src/` is under Live2D Open Software License. The original license and notice files are retained. `framework.js` is a local bundle of the listed Framework sources. `web/public/cubism-shaders/` contains the corresponding official WebGL shaders. No sample character assets are included.

Source: https://www.live2d.com/en/sdk/download/web/

The bundled Core and Framework are for internal validation. A product that imports arbitrary third-party models must complete the applicable Live2D expandable application publication review before external release.
